name: Apple Magic Keyboard A1644 (USB)
notes: 182-byte report descriptor of the keyboard interface (interface 1) of a real Apple Magic Keyboard A1644, from the usb-hid-device-report-corpus dump of the device: https://github.com/steve-chamberlin/usb-hid-device-report-corpus/blob/37179eb6d8c61847c27a6def827a9dce39bf608d/keyboards/05AC-0267 Apple Magic Keyboard A1644, USB cable.txt#L186-L197. The source gives the device's name, not its own USB strings, so productString is that name. Other interfaces of the real device are not part of this profile.
